description.value: East Vancouver Brewing is a craft microbrewery and taproom rooted in the East Van neighbourhood at Venables Street and Commercial Drive, known for award-winning dark beers including the Humble Hive Honey Brown Ale brewed with honey from beehives kept on the brewery roof. The full-service taproom pairs its 12+ rotating and flagship beers with a proper kitchen (run by Barley & Rye) serving stacked sandwiches, soups, and share plates. A loyalty app, online delivery, and same-day delivery via Uber Eats and Skip the Dishes make it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through East Van.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and corroborates the OSM address (1675 Venables Street), phone ((604) 558-3822), and URL. The site confirms takeout/delivery via Uber Eats and Skip the Dishes. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible craft brewery and taproom with a full food menu and confirmed online presence. Clear stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.
